course_name: 使用者經驗資料收集與分析
outline:
產品與服務的開發與設計主要在提升使用者的經驗。以此課程教授使用者經驗的概念與其資料收集與分析的方法。學生將能了解使用者經驗的概念、其資料的收集的方法與資料形式，以及相關之實驗設計與統計分析的方法。
The primary objective of the development and design of products and services is to enhance user experience. The concept of user experience and the methods for its data collection and analysis will be taught in the course. Students will learn the user experience concept, the methods of data collection and the formats of collected data, as well as related methods of experimental design and statistical analysis.

Week 02: What is an experiment for UX
Week 03: Designing an experiment for UX
Week 04: Response measures: The task
Week 05: No class (Holiday)
Week 06: Response measures: Free description
Week 07: Response measures: Rating scale
Week 08: Response measures: Forced choice
Week 09: Response measures: Specialized multiple choice
Week 10: Response measures: Real world tasks
Week 11: Response measures: Physiology
Week 12: Stimuli: Choosing stimuli
Week 13: Stimuli: Presenting stimuli
Week 14: Data analysis: Statistical issues I
Week 15: Data analysis: Statistical issues II
Week 16: Data analysis: Free description questionnaires and rating scales
Week 17: Data analysis: Forced and multiple choice
Week 18: Final report
